prompt_meta.title: GA Push Notifications: Device registration + notification preferences + deep-link actions (Mobile-first, Web optional) + GitHub push

owner_actions.when: only if IDE chooses FCM/APNs directly (not Expo push) or if required for standalone builds
owner_actions.instruction: Provide Firebase/APNs artifacts and identifiers as requested in ops/PUSH_SETUP.md (do not run commands). If not available, IDE must keep dev non-blocking and document what is needed later.

owner_actions.when: after STEP-0014 report is shared with ChatGPT
owner_actions.instruction: Approve notification types, default preferences, and quiet-hours behavior described in ops/NOTIFICATION_PREFERENCES.md.

step_objectives.goal: Ship GA-grade push notifications: register devices, respect user preferences, send pushes for key events, and deep-link users into the right screen from push taps.
outcomes: Mobile app can request permissions, register a device token, and keep token up to date
API stores device registrations per user and supports multiple devices
Users can configure notification preferences (types + quiet hours + enable/disable)
Server sends push for key events (at minimum: game join approved/denied/cancelled, new chat message, waitlist promoted)
Push payloads open the correct destination using deep links/navigation actions
No secrets in repo; configuration via env + GitHub Secrets (CI safe)
Code is pushed to GitHub and CI remains green
constraints: Mobile-first push is mandatory; web push is optional (only implement if straightforward and non-blocking).
Owner does not execute commands locally.
definition_of_done: Push provider implemented (prefer non-blocking dev path) and documented; provider swappable design
Device registration endpoints exist and are tested
Notification preferences endpoints exist and are tested
Event-driven push delivery wired for critical events (games + chat) with preference checks
Push tap opens correct screen (deep link / navigation) on mobile
pnpm -r integrity, lint, test, build all pass
Changes committed and pushed to main on GitHub
Docs written: ops/PUSH_SETUP.md, ops/NOTIFICATION_PREFERENCES.md, ops/PUSH_PAYLOADS.md, ops/PUSH_PROVIDER_NOTES.md

requirements: Register token with API when authenticated; remove/disable on logout if appropriate.
Support multiple devices per user with platform/app version metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Mobile tests mock notification APIs and verify registration call flow

requirements: Preferences model supports per-type enable/disable and quiet hours (timezone-aware).
Preferences enforced server-side before sending any push.
acceptance_criteria: Web + Mobile settings UI exists (simple is fine) and localized

requirements: Send push for: chat message (participant-only games), game approvals/denials, game cancelled, waitlist promoted (at minimum).
Use safe payload fields (no sensitive data), include deep-link target info.
Handle provider errors and invalid tokens (best-effort cleanup).
acceptance_criteria: API tests validate 'send attempted' logic and token filtering
Report includes delivery flow description and logs/tails

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Push is actionable, not just informational.
requirements: Tapping push opens correct destination: game detail, chat, or notifications list.
Unauth/onboarding states route correctly (login/onboarding then redirect).
No secrets committed. Any keys via env vars + GitHub Secrets if needed.
Update integrity script rules if needed to ensure configs aren’t accidentally committed.
CI remains green and caches continue to work.
acceptance_criteria: CI workflows pass and are still required checks

requirements: Commit all changes with clear message.
acceptance_criteria: Report includes pushed commit hash and push evidence

tasks.name: Choose push provider + implement swappable abstraction
tasks.objective: Prefer a dev-non-blocking provider (e.g., Expo push) while keeping a clear path to FCM/APNs; document tradeoffs.
acceptance: Docs exist + implementation works in dev and is testable

tasks.name: Device registration API + storage
tasks.objective: Create endpoints/models to store device tokens and metadata per user and manage lifecycle.

tasks.name: Preferences API + UI
tasks.objective: Add per-type preferences + quiet hours and UI on Web + Mobile.

tasks.name: Wire push delivery to events
tasks.objective: Trigger pushes for key events (chat + games) with preference checks and safe payloads.
acceptance: Verified via tests/mocks and report evidence

tasks.name: Deep-link actions from push taps
tasks.objective: Map payloads to navigation routes; handle unauth/onboarding redirects.
acceptance: Mobile tests cover mapping and redirect behavior (mocked)

tasks.name: Quality gates + push to GitHub
tasks.objective: Run integrity/lint/test/build, then commit and push to main.
acceptance: Push evidence + commit hash in report

final_instruction_to_ide: Execute this prompt exactly. Do not delegate any execution to the owner. Choose implementation freely. Implement mobile push + preferences + deep-link actions, keep CI green, do not commit secrets, commit and push to GitHub main, update ops/manifest.json, and write a complete reports/STEP-0014.report.json with no placeholders.
